harness_os_probe_back_to_back_signal_mer.what: harness self-probe of the OS, NOT a heimdall-proto measurement: a Python wrapper written by the harness sends each signal twice back to back with kill() to the harness's signal-counting child (heimdall-proto is not involved); deliveries_per_trial counts what that child saw, i.e. whether this kernel merges two identical pending standard signals.
